title: FastMM: how fast it is, in a 13-hour production session on Binance

sections.heading: FastMM: how fast it is, in a 13-hour production session on Binance
sections.text:
# How fast it is

<video class="fastmm-video" controls preload="none" poster="../../assets/intro-poster.jpg" src="https://github.com/ziyangliu-666/FastMM/releases/download/v0.5.1/fastmm-intro.mp4"></video>

In a live `fastmm-live` session on Binance, market data became an order in 6.7 µs at the median. The session ran 45 hours 39 minutes without a restart on 2 physical cores ([Cores](../how-to/operations/running-in-production.md#cores)). The engine alone: [Benchmarks](benchmarks.md).

sections.heading: FastMM: how fast it is, in a 13-hour production session on Binance: Market data to order
sections.text:
From the market-data frame read (T0) to the order handed to the network thread (T5), as the [status file](../reference/status-file.md#latency-intervals) reports them:

| Interval | Count | p50 | p99 | p99.9 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Decode (T0 to T1) | 306,617,750 | 0.61 µs | 5.6 µs | 12.3 µs |
| Book apply (T1 to T2) | 306,617,750 | 0.96 µs | 30.7 µs | 4.46 ms |
| Strategy (T2 to T3) | 306,617,750 | 1.15 µs | 3.5 µs | 24.6 µs |
| Serialize (T3 to T4) | 1,386,841 | 0.96 µs | 47.1 µs | 77.8 µs |
| Send (T4 to T5) | 1,728,607 | 0.50 µs | 1.7 µs | 23.6 µs |
| Tick to trade (T0 to T5) | 1,706,236 | 6.7 µs | 81.9 µs | 4.06 ms |

Book apply and tick to trade include the time an event waits in the ring while the engine is busy or descheduled, because T1 is stamped on a network thread and T2 on the engine thread.

sections.heading: FastMM: how fast it is, in a 13-hour production session on Binance: On the wire
sections.text:
From T0 to the return of the `write` that carried the signed, TLS-encrypted order, per account:

| Account | Samples | p50 | p99 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 358,396 | 23.9 µs | 136.5 µs |
| 2 | 356,564 | 23.9 µs | 273.1 µs |
| 3 | 357,678 | 23.9 µs | 259.4 µs |
| 4 | 355,920 | 24.7 µs | 259.4 µs |
| 5 | 357,773 | 24.7 µs | 259.4 µs |

sections.heading: FastMM: how fast it is, in a 13-hour production session on Binance: Load
sections.text:
| Over the session | Count |
|---|---|
| Market-data messages | 1.03 billion, about 6,300 a second; 0 dropped, 0 malformed |
| Engine events | 328 million |
| Orders | 952,762 placed, 949,953 cancelled |
| Orders refused for a rate limit by a venue | 0 |
| Reconnects | 3 |
| Book resynchronisations | 72 |
| Kill switch trips | 0 |
| Store records dropped | 0 |
